train_part_classifier: train a part classifier using the Trainer class with a dataset and specified hyperparameters
create_dataset_json: create a Dataset_JSON instance to load bird or generic part annotation JSON files for training
evaluate_classifier_accuracy: evaluate the trained classifier on test data and save prediction results as text and images
save_load_model_checkpoint: save or load a classifier model checkpoint using the Trainer save and load methods
render_vector_to_raster: render vector stroke data into a raster image using the processed_part_to_raster method
